system.description:
Kong is a potent drug cocktail that boosts the aggressiveness of non-human primates. Uplifts and smart animals under the influence of kong must make a WIL x 3 Test or automatically attack anyone that exhibits threatening behavior. Kong users can ignore the effects of 1 wound, receive a +5 SOM bonus and a +10 bonus on melee attacks, but suffer a −5 INT modifier. Once engaged in violence, the affected primate must make a WIL x 3 Test to not automatically attack the next nearest target. Attempts to control primates under the influence of kong suffer a −30 modifier to their Animal Handling Tests. Once the effects of this drug wear off, the user suffers −5 SOM for an equivalent duration.

Source: Eclipse Phase Panopticon, p. 151.
